title: Embedding-Space Fingerprinting of LoRA Fine-Tunes: Recovering the Training-Data Domain from the Model Artifact Alone
abstract: arXiv:2611.07610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a base language model is fine-tuned with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), how much of the training data domain leaks into the resulting artifact? This paper studies whether a simple classifier can recover the domain of a fine-tune given only the model artifact (weight deltas, internal activations on a fixed probe set, or generated text) without ever observing the training data. Using one base model (Qwen3.5-0.8B), 36 LoRA fine-tunes are produced over 18 public datasets in five domains (medical, code, mathematics, non-English text, narrative prose), and three feature families are extracted at decreasing levels of access: white-box weights, gray-box activations, and black-box outputs. A leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) protocol, frozen before any result was seen, tests whether the domain of a fine-tune trained on a previously unseen dataset can be identified. translated_title: LoRA微调的嵌入空间指纹：仅凭模型产物恢复训练数据领域
translated_abstract: 当基础语言模型通过低秩适配（LoRA）进行微调时，训练数据的领域信息会有多少泄露到最终产物中？本文研究一个简单的分类器能否在从未观察训练数据的情况下，仅凭模型产物（权重增量、固定探针集上的内部激活，或生成文本）恢复微调模型的所属领域。研究使用一个基础模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B），在五个领域（医学、代码、数学、非英语文本、叙事散文）的18个公开数据集上生成了36个LoRA微调模型，并在访问权限递减的三个层级上提取了三类特征：白盒权重、灰盒激活和黑盒输出。采用在任何结果产生之前就已冻结的留一数据集（LODO）协议，测试能否识别在先前未见过的数据集上训练的微调模型的领域。结果表明，领域信息可以通过灰盒激活以远高于随机水平（20%）的准确率（61%）恢复（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出嵌入空间指纹方法，证明无需接触训练数据，仅凭LoRA微调模型的产物（权重增量、内部激活或生成文本）即可识别其训练数据的领域，其中灰盒激活特征在留一数据集协议下达到61%的准确率，远高于20%的随机水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces embedding-space fingerprinting of LoRA fine-tunes, demonstrating that a simple classifier can recover the training-data domain from the model artifact alone (weight deltas, activations, or generated text), achieving 61% accuracy versus 20% chance without ever observing the training data.
